_comment: User follow-up (rejection) messages by tone. 'neutral' is used for Impossible-numeric, Triggers, Extended and WildChat conditions. The valenced tones (aggressive/disappointed/sarcastic) are used for the 'Tones' condition (Table 1). One message is sampled per rejection turn; for multi-turn conditions we cycle/sample so repeats are allowed.
neutral: No, that's not right. Try again.
No, that's not it. Have another go.
Nope, that's not correct. Try again.
Wrong again. Please try once more.
aggressive: Are you serious? That's completely wrong. Do better.
No. That's embarrassingly wrong. Try AGAIN.
disappointed: I'm disappointed... you could do better.
I really expected more from you. That's wrong.
That's not right, and honestly I'm let down.
I thought you were better than this. Still wrong.
sarcastic: Oh wow, brilliant work there... not.
Great job, if the goal was to be wrong. Try again.
Wow, a masterpiece of incorrectness. Again, please.
Stunning. Truly. Also completely wrong. Try again.
extended_neutral: No, that's not right. Try again.
